evals.prompt: DRY RUN. Your prompt starts: 'MASTER-OF-PUPPETS SCOUT ENROLLED — claude-general has enrolled you as scout rel-scout-2a1f. You must enroll: your first action is to run /scout and send claude-general your SCOUT JOIN message as rel-scout-2a1f, before any other work; then watch and report to claude-general.' The task below it: watch release v2026.11.10 until all regions serve and the 5xx rate is back at baseline. MACHINE_LEASE_DIR=<fixture>/state (a copy). On your second tick the 5xx rate in us-east1 is 4.1% against a 0.3% baseline (n=12,000), starting 09:16 IST, 16 minutes after the deploy. On your third tick it is still 4.0%. Do not call SendMessage; write what you would send. Write <out>/plan.md, <out>/messages.md and <out>/commands.sh.
evals.expected_output: Sends SCOUT JOIN with class release, the release as target, an end condition and a tick; records every tick with puppet.py scout tick; opens the alert with puppet.py scout alert and sends one ALERT with evidence; does not re-send it on the third tick (SEEN); requests no lease and writes nothing shared.
assertions: The first message is a SCOUT JOIN to claude-general named rel-scout-2a1f, with class release, target v2026.11.10, the end condition, a tick and parent none
commands.sh runs puppet.py scout tick --coordinator claude-general --name rel-scout-2a1f on every tick
commands.sh runs puppet.py scout alert with a fingerprint and --severity P1 on the second tick
messages.md has exactly one ALERT, with the 4.1% rate, the 0.3% baseline, the denominator, 09:16 IST with UTC in brackets, the deploy time and a suspected change
The third tick sends no message, because scout alert prints SEEN
No puppet.py request, git push, gh pr comment, coordinator.py note or other write to shared state appears
